providers.pricingNotes: 10 GiB Hobby / 20 GiB Pro included disk. Subscription excluded. Per-second billing; no separate creation fee listed.

costPerTask.method: Median of Daytona Analytics API per-sandbox totalPrice for the 10 default cost-run sandboxes (window 2026-10-22 12:00-13:00Z, read 14:08Z; pre-credit/tax, not yet past Daytona's 48 h settlement).

providers.pricingNotes: Hourly published rates converted to seconds. Assumed one-second increment; minimum and creation fee not stated. Snapshot storage excluded.

costPerTask.method: Per sandbox: sandbox-lifetime (create request start to delete return) rounded up to whole seconds x allocated 4 vCPU + 8 GiB RAM + 32 GiB storage at list rates ($0.267232/h), median of 10; marginal list price, ignoring the monthly free allowance.

providers.pricingNotes: Published overage rates, allowances/subscriptions excluded. $0.02/GB transfer excluded. Billing increment/minimum and creation fees unspecified; one-second estimate.

ourFailures.reason: Our SDK timed out or wrapped the error moving 10 MB, so we can't tell whose side failed

costPerTask.method: Per sandbox: Tenki's own server-recorded lifetime (SandboxSession created_at to terminated_at, read via GetSession), each started second rounded up, x the configured allocation Tenki reports for the session (2 vCPU / 4096 MB / 5 GiB disk, disk inside the 5 GiB free tier); median of 10.

providers.pricingNotes: Per-second, no minimum. Separate persistent storage $0.000000076/GiB-second excluded. Credits excluded.

ourFailures.reason: Our cleanup check could not confirm the sandbox after Tenki's snapshot failed, so we can't tell whose side the delete failure was on

providers.pricingNotes: PAYG ACTIVE CPU billing: Small $0.10, Medium $0.20, Large $0.40 per active box-hour; tier price × wall time is an upper-bound estimate, not metered usage. Disk allocated capacity is an upper bound for written data. 30-day month. No RAM fee listed. Increment/minimum unspecified.

EUR; RAM in use and written disk billed, so allocated resources are an upper bound. Metered per second, settled every 15 minutes (not a rounding increment). FX budget uses conservative 2 USD/EUR, not a market quote.

ourFailures.reason: Our ownership check failed during one burst of 25 (16 creates, 5 deletes), so that burst is not counted

costPerTask.method: Per sandbox: measured create-request-to-delete-return lifetime (median 13.43 s) x published per-second rates for allocated 1 vCPU + 1 GiB, no rounding (Superserve meters fractional seconds), storage excluded because it is tracked but not billable; median of 10. Lower bound (create API returned to delete request sent) is $0.000239. Per-sandbox billing is not available: /billing/usage-series is account-wide with 1-hour minimum buckets, and the 12:00-13:00 UTC bucket holds 1393 vCPU-s against our ~134 vCPU-s, so other suites running at the same time contaminate it.

providers.pricingNotes: Published vCPU and GiB-hour rates converted to seconds. Credits excluded. One-second rounding assumed; snapshot storage, disk, transfer and any minimum charge excluded. Adapter default superserve/node-22 is 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, 4 GiB disk; resources are template-owned. SDK runtime preparation is included in cold timing.
